title: Surface 2 Candidate Parity: Restore Visual Template Previews, Interactive PreviewModal, ShareModal, Rich Text Formatting and ATS Resume Selection
spec:
# IME365 DIR-007 — SURFACE 2 CANDIDATE PARITY & WORKSPACE GAP CLOSURE
## Authoritative Engineering Directive: Full Interactive Parity across Resume Builder, PreviewModal, Template Catalog, ShareModal, Rich Text & ATS Analyzer

**Directive ID:** DIR-007  
**Priority:** P0 — Critical  
**Target Surface:** Candidate Dashboard & Creation Workspaces (Surface 2 Parity Restoration)  
**Executive Engineering Lead:** Antigravity (Google DeepMind)  
**Implementation Engine:** Claude Code CLI / Codex  

---

### SECTION 1 — EXECUTIVE MANDATE
Forensic audit of the modernized candidate dashboard revealed critical functional regressions:
1. Dead Controls: The top "Preview" button in frontend/src/pages/dashboard/resume-builder.tsx has no click handler and does nothing.
2. Simulated Placeholders: Step 12 ("Review & Template") renders static grey divs ({/* Simulated resume layout */}) instead of real template screenshots or live rendered preview cards.
3. Resumes List Gaps: /dashboard/resumes cards render generic <FileText /> icons and "Default" text with no visual thumbnails, no skills tags, no summary snippet, and native browser confirm() / alert() instead of an accessible Cuba ShareModal.
4. Missing Rich Formatting: Description and summary inputs use raw <Textarea> without bullet lists, bold, or italic formatting controls.
5. ATS Analyzer Resume Binding: /dashboard/ats and /dashboard/ats-score post job description without letting candidates choose which saved resume to evaluate.

The mandate is to implement 100% true interactive parity with zero capability loss while preserving the Cuba Modern Executive Glassmorphism standard.

---

### SECTION 2 — PLAN MODE VS ACT MODE BOUNDARIES
- **Plan Mode**: Implementer investigates src/components/BuildResume/, src/components/Dashboard/, and src/assets/resumesNew/. Develops surgical implementation plan. No application code changes before plan approval.
- **Act Mode**: Upon Lead plan approval (bridge lead approve-plan --directive DIR-007), implementer executes the approved changes in frontend/src/ and validates with test gates.

---

### SECTION 3 — PRE-FLIGHT REPOSITORY VERIFICATION
1. Verify working tree state: git status --short.
2. Inspect legacy assets in src/assets/resumesNew/ (Cv1.JPG...Cv51.JPG).
3. Inspect legacy modals: src/components/BuildResume/PreviewModal.jsx, TemplateSelectionModal.jsx, ShareModal.jsx.
4. Confirm frontend/ builds cleanly: npm --prefix frontend run build.

---

### SECTION 4 — PROJECT INVARIANTS REGISTER
1. **ZERO CAPABILITY LOSS**: Full preservation of all 51 resume templates and high-fidelity A4 page composition.
2. **CUBA DESIGN SYSTEM**: All new modals and dialogs must use Cuba glassmorphic styling, Radix UI dialog primitives, and WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard/focus trap.
3. **NO MOCK DATA**: Resumes list, sharing, and ATS analysis must bind strictly to authentic backend REST endpoints.
4. **PERFORMANCE BUDGET**: TypeScript compilation must pass cleanly (tsc -b), and Vite build must compile in under 3.0 seconds.

---

### SECTION 9 — TEST STRATEGY & ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. **PreviewModal Gate**: Clicking the "Preview" button in resume-builder.tsx opens an accessible A4 preview modal with zoom, live candidate data, and direct export actions.
2. **Template Catalog Gate**: Step 12 template switcher displays real visual template thumbnail images (ported from src/assets/resumesNew/ to frontend/public/templates/).
3. **Resumes List Gate**: /dashboard/resumes renders real template thumbnails, skills tags, summary snippet, and an accessible Cuba ShareModal with public link toggle and copy button.
4. **Rich Text Gate**: Work experience and summary fields support bullet lists and bold formatting.
5. **ATS Score Gate**: Candidate can select any saved resume from a dropdown selector to score against job descriptions.
6. **Build Gate**: npm --prefix frontend run build exits 0 with zero TypeScript errors.

---

### SECTION 11 — SEVERITY & WAVE SEQUENCING
- **Wave 1 (Critical Visual & Interactive Fixes)**:
  - Copy src/assets/resumesNew/*.JPG to frontend/public/templates/.
  - Wire template thumbnails in Step 12 template picker and /dashboard/resumes cards.
  - Implement accessible PreviewModal with zoom and print/download triggers.
- **Wave 2 (Modals & Formatting)**:
  - Implement accessible Cuba ShareModal in frontend/src/components/ui/share-modal.tsx and bind to /dashboard/resumes.
  - Add bullet formatting controls or lightweight rich-text toolbar to experience and summary inputs.
  - Add resume dropdown selector to /dashboard/ats and /dashboard/ats-score.
- **Wave 3 (Verification & Regression)**:
  - Run npm --prefix frontend run build (tsc -b && vite build).
  - Copy built bundle to dist/ and verify http://ime365.local/.

---

### SECTION 13 — BRIDGE SUBMISSION SYNTAX
Developer submits plan via:
bridge dev plan --directive DIR-007 --summary "<summary>" --steps "<steps>"
Developer wakes lead:
bridge dev wake-lead --directive DIR-007 --reason "Plan submitted"
Developer submits evidence via:
bridge dev submit-evidence --directive DIR-007 --summary "<summary>" --tests "<log>"

AUTHENTIC BACKEND CONTRACTS: No fake mock data in production; resume list and sharing bind to authentic REST endpoints.

acceptanceCriteria: Preview button in resume-builder.tsx opens interactive A4 PreviewModal with live resume data and export triggers.
Template catalog in Step 12 displays real visual template thumbnails instead of simulated grey boxes.
Resumes list (/dashboard/resumes) renders real template thumbnails, skills chips, and interactive ShareModal.
Experience and summary inputs support bullet list formatting and rich text controls.
ATS Score analysis page provides a resume selector dropdown to evaluate specific saved resumes.

Playwright tests pass with zero console errors.

plan.summary: Complete Surface 2 Candidate Parity: Wire interactive PreviewModal, port 51 template JPG thumbnails to public/templates (DONE), enhance resumes list with real thumbnails and Cuba ShareModal, add rich text / bullet formatting to experience & summary, add resume selector dropdown to ATS score checker.
steps: Phase 1 (DONE): Assets already copied - 51 template JPGs in frontend/public/templates/; template catalog metadata in src/utils/templateCatalog.js authoritative

Phase 2: Create Cuba PreviewModal in frontend/src/components/ui/preview-modal.tsx using Radix Dialog, TemplateRenderer, zoom/print/download, wire 'Preview' button in resume-builder.tsx top bar (line 371-374)

Phase 3: Update resumes.tsx - replace FileText/Default with real template thumbnails from /templates/, add skills chips, summary snippet, build ShareModal component (Cuba glassmorphic), replace confirm()/alert() with accessible dialogs

Phase 4: Integrate Lexical RichTextEditor (from src/components/BuildResume/steps/components/RichTextEditor.jsx) into resume-builder.tsx ExperienceStep (description) and SummaryStep (summary) for bullet/bold/italic formatting
Phase 5: Update ats-score.tsx - add saved resume selector dropdown fetching from /resumes endpoint, bind to ATS analyze call
Phase 6: Build verification - npm run build (tsc -b + vite build <3s), copy dist to production, verify http://ime365.local/

planApproval.feedback: Plan approved under Lead Takeover. Proceed to ACT implementation.
